Rae (Marketing Ops): FYI we had ~18 leads route to fallback this AM because enrichment didn't finish before the claim check. Hitting SLA.

Samir (Sales Ops): Yikes. Any common source?

Rae (Marketing Ops): Mostly webinar forms with attachments + a few partner API calls. Logs show enrichment PATCH arriving at +9-11s. Claim window is 4s.

Leah (Platform): Two pragmatic fixes: 1) bump claim window globally to 10s (simpler), 2) optimistic soft-assign to a transient owner and reassign after enrichment. I recommend soft-assign to avoid global latency impact.

Kai (Growth): Soft-assign preferred. Reps see it immediately but we can suppress outreach. Need a clear property so analytics and SFDC can filter.

Samir (Sales Ops): Agree, but ensure no duplicate notifications when we reassign. Also TTL so a lead doesn't stay in transient owner forever.

Leah (Platform): Proposed config: 
```
OPTIMISTIC_ASSIGN=true
TRANSIENT_OWNER="Holding - Await Enrich"
TRANSIENT_FLAG=enrich_pending
TRANSIENT_TTL_S=1800
SUPPRESS_NOTIFICATIONS_WHILE_FLAG=true
WAIT_FOR_ENRICH_MS=10000
```
Behavior: immediate transient assign, wait up to 10s for enrichment; if enrichment completes -> run RR and reassign with note "Auto-reassigned after enrichment (prev Holding)". Emit metrics `lead.transient_assigned`, `lead.reassigned_after_enrich`.

Rae (Marketing Ops): I'll update the HS workflow to set `enrich_pending` on intake and make sure PR includes the reassign note text.

leadwatch-bot: canary deploy queued: lead-router -> staging (build #1345).

Kai (Growth): Canary plan: 500 synthetic leads, 30% large payloads. Metrics to check: transient_rate, reassign_success, duplicate_notify_count, avg_time-to-final-owner. Targets: reassign_success >90%, duplicate_notify <3%.

Samir (Sales Ops): I'll prepare SFDC rule to map `enrich_pending` -> `Unverified` queue and suppress tasks there. Also will send a short note to SDR leads explaining behavior.

Leah (Platform): Timeline: staging deploy now, canary at 2:30pm PT, review 3:30pm PT. Rollback plan: set OPTIMISTIC_ASSIGN=false, TRANSIENT_TTL=0, clear enrich_pending flag via batch. I will own rollback.

Rae (Marketing Ops): Please post canary dashboard links and sample lead ids here after run. If reassign_success <85% we abort.

Kai (Growth): Also capture a short screencap for SDRs so they know what to look for.

Leah (Platform): Will post results. Ping me if you want to tweak TTL or notification suppression before prod.

Rae (Marketing Ops): Thanks team ":thumbsup:"
